title: Felt Glass Druqks
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: dense IDM breakbeat. Register focus: melody/chord-led — felt piano over chopped breaks. Palette: CasioRZ1 break bank + felt piano. Tempo: 156 BPM. Arc shape: early peak then deconstruction. Mood modifier: bittersweet, intricate, Druqks-like.
description: A bittersweet felt-piano line drifts over chopped CasioRZ1 breakbeats that ratchet and stutter into IDM territory. It peaks early in a dense intricate flurry, then deconstructs — drums fall away to leave the piano ringing in reverb before a brittle, glitchy outro.
code:
setcpm(156/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>/2").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.62),
    s("hh*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)).degradeBy(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.95),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.45).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(1.0).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh*8").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.4).cut(1).ply("<1 1 2 4>").crush(8),
    s("sd(3,8,1)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).speed("<1 1.5>").sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.6),
    n("0 3 5 <7 10>").scale("C4:minor").s("piano").gain(0.4).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)).room(0.35)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).gain(0.62),
    n("0 ~ 3 ~ 5 ~ <7 10> ~").scale("C4:minor").s("piano").gain(0.42).room(0.5).delay(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(1.0).every(4, x => x.ply(2)).every(8, x => x.rev()),
    s("hh*8").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.42).cut(1).ply("<1 2 1 4>").crush(7),
    s("rim(5,8)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.45).coarse("<1 2 4>"),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.6),
    n("0 3 5 <7 10>").scale("C4:minor").s("piano").gain(0.4).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)).room(0.35)
  )],
  [14, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>/2").s("piano").room(0.6).gain(0.6),
    s("hh*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.35).degradeBy(0.5).crush(6).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7))
  )]
)
